Frequently Asked Questions

What is an AI website readiness audit?

An AI website readiness audit checks if your website is optimized for AI search agents and answer engines like ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and ClaudeBot. We scan your website robots.txt rules, check for the emerging standard llms.txt context specifications, validate JSON-LD structured schema schemas, and audit image vision ALT tags.

Why do I need a schema.org validation?

Structured data (JSON-LD) enables search models to correctly interpret details about your application, pricing structures, products, and services. Without incomplete structured data schemas, AI search bots might make wrong assumptions or omit your platform entirely when presenting query answers to prospective customers.

What is the purpose of the llms.txt standard?

The llms.txt standard provides clean markdown context pages specifically optimized for LLM crawlers. By serving structured information in a lightweight format, you make it significantly easier for AI indexing engines to understand the exact scope and functionality of your site.
